UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Per-user badminton club daily session settings (no PII stored).

sessionDate.description: Local session date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

courtCount.description: Configured court count (0 means uninitialized, 1..24 active).

autoArrange.description: Whether 3-minute automatic matchmaking is currently enabled.

nextAutoArrangeAt.description: Epoch ms of next scheduled auto-arrange tick (0 when disabled).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session document was last updated.

Court.title: Court
Court.description: A badminton doubles court with name, up to 4 active player IDs, and match start time.

playerIds.description: 0 or 4 player document IDs currently playing on this court.

startedAt.description: Epoch ms when the current match started (0 when empty).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when court was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when court was last updated.

Player.title: Player
Player.description: A badminton club player with rating, win/loss stats, last played time, and current queue status.

lastPlayedAt.description: Last played local time in HH:mm format (initial 00:00).

lastPlayedTs.description: Epoch ms of last played match (0 initially).

waitingSince.description: Epoch ms when player entered waiting pool.

paused.description: Whether the player is paused and excluded from automatic matchmaking.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when player was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when player was last updated.

QueueGroup.title: QueueGroup
QueueGroup.description: An arranged group of 4 doubles players waiting in queue order.

playerIds.description: Exactly 4 player document IDs in balanced doubles order.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when queue group was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when queue group was last updated.

MatchRecord.title: MatchRecord
MatchRecord.description: Immutable completed badminton doubles match record.

courtName.description: Name of the court where match was played.

playerIds.description: 1 to 4 participant player IDs for array-contains queries.

players.description: 1 to 4 participant result maps {playerId, name, score, ratingDelta, ratingAfter}.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when match was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Root per-user session configuration document (master gate for subcollections).

/users/{userId}/courts/{courtId}.description: Active courts owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/players/{playerId}.description: Players participating in the user's badminton session.

/users/{userId}/queueGroups/{groupId}.description: Arranged doubles groups waiting to take a court.

/users/{userId}/matches/{matchId}.description: Completed match history records for the user's session.
